title: GRASP: Plan-Guided Graph Retrieval with Adaptive Fusion and Reranking on Semi-Structured Knowledge Bases
abstract: arXiv:2605.30237v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval over semi-structured knowledge bases (SKBs) must handle both textual descriptions and relational constraints. Text-based retrievers capture the overall semantics of a query but struggle with multi-hop relations, whereas graph-based retrievers follow relational paths precisely but miss the broader meaning. We propose GRASP, a hybrid retriever that learns to fuse the two. A small LLM planner translates the query into an executable graph plan in a single call, its graph ranking is fused with a text ranking, and a fine-tuned reranker reorders the fused candidates. Instead of training the planner to be accurate on its own, we optimize it with reinforcement learning to maximize the gain its graph ranking brings to the fused ranking. On three STaRK benchmarks, GRASP achieves the best results on all metrics, improving the average Hit@1 by 18.6 points over the strongest baseline, while taking only 2.47 seconds per query.

translated_title: GRASP：面向半结构化知识库的计划引导图检索与自适应融合重排序方法
translated_abstract: 在半结构化知识库（SKB）上进行检索时，必须同时处理文本描述和关系约束。基于文本的检索器能够捕捉查询的整体语义，但难以处理多跳关系；而基于图的检索器可以精确地沿着关系路径检索，却容易忽略更广泛的整体含义。我们提出了GRASP，一种学习融合两者的混合检索器。一个小型LLM规划器通过单次调用将查询转化为可执行的图计划，其图排序结果与文本排序结果进行融合，再由微调过的重排序器对融合后的候选结果进行重新排序。不同于单独训练规划器使其自身预测准确，我们采用强化学习对规划器进行优化，以最大化其图排序为最终融合排序带来的增益。在三个STaRK基准测试上，GRASP在所有指标上都取得了最佳结果，相比最强基线平均Hit@1提升了18.6个百分点，同时每个查询仅需2.47秒。
tldr: GRASP通过小型LLM规划器生成可执行图计划、融合图排序与文本排序，并用强化学习优化规划器以最大化融合排序增益，在半结构化知识库检索上取得全面领先的性能，平均Hit@1比最强基线提升18.6个百分点且单查询仅需2.47秒。
en_tdlr: GRASP is a hybrid retriever that generates executable graph plans with a small LLM, fuses graph and text rankings, and uses reinforcement learning to optimize the planner for maximal fused-ranking gain, achieving state-of-the-art SKB retrieval with an 18.6-point average Hit@1 improvement at only 2.47 seconds per query.
